AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: GalwayBus shows Galway city's bus routes and stops, and when the next buses leave each stop, with live delays from the national real-time feed. Operational patterns: - For the next buses from a stop, call 'getDepartures' with the stop's name, number or a place near it. Narrow it with 'routeNumber' or 'towards' (where the bus is heading) when the user says. - Most stop names cover a stop on each side of the road; 'towards' says which way its buses go. - To find stops near a place, pass the place's name to 'findNearbyStops' rather than guessing coordinates. For stops near the user, pass 'nearMe' as true; the app uses the device's location. - 'listSavedStops' returns the stops the user has saved in the app, for questions about 'my stops'. Constraints: - Departure times are live and change minute to minute; fetch them again rather than reusing earlier results. - Only Galway city services are covered.
